title: Studio action editor: no control grants a script action's body.capabilities, so a sandboxed-JS action that reads or writes data is refused 403 on every click
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXSZs9PBUc2H8z6mtB

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: Studio's Actions tab → Advanced → "Run a script", then the action door `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION`, 2 fresh loads).
Business reason: Studio offers "Run a script" (Sandboxed JS) in its action editor. The obvious use is a script that touches data, for example stamping a field on the clicked record. Such a body needs `body.capabilities` (`api.read`, `api.write`), and the runtime says exactly that when it refuses. The editor has no control for it, so an author can build and publish an action that every user's click refuses. The only fix is to edit raw metadata outside Studio. The Hooks tab already has a Capabilities control (#26726); actions do not.
Reader who acts: the ui lane (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`). Render the Capabilities control for the L2 script body, as `HookDefaultInspector` does.
Dedupe: `action editor capabilities` 76 hits and `script action capabilities Studio` 116 (run records, #28577 skills/docs, #28236 epic, all other subjects; #26903 closed, the hook-side refusal code). No card covers the action editor's missing control.

QA-source: #29172 · studio-authoring.actions-tab-presets · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

A script action authored in Studio with a body that writes data is refused at run time:

`POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION` `{"recordId":"ID"}` → **403** `INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES` — "capability 'api.write' not granted to action … Grant it by adding 'api.write' to the action's body.capabilities."

The editor offers no place to add it. A capability-free body (one that only returns a value) runs fine, so the editor and the door otherwise work.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot with a scratch package, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction

1. In Studio, open `/_console/studio/PKG/data`, pick an object, go to Actions → New → Advanced → New action.
2. Set What it does to "Run a script" and Script language to "Sandboxed JS (L2)".
3. Enter the body `await ctx.api.object('OBJ').update({ id: ctx.recordId, stamp: 'x' }); return { ok: true };` and choose Publish all.
4. As any user with edit access, open a record and click the action.
5. **Expected:** the author can grant `api.write` in the editor, and the click updates the record.
6. **Actual:** the click answers 403 as above. No Capabilities control exists anywhere in the action editor.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)

- `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` keeps `capabilities` in the JS body's key set (around L178: `['js', new Set(['language', 'source', 'capabilities', 'timeoutMs', 'memoryMb'])]`) but renders no input for it.
- `HookDefaultInspector.tsx` renders Capabilities checkboxes for hooks (#26726).
- The runtime refuses the ungranted call in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` (`throwCapabilityDenial`).
